verdict.rationale: Questionnaire import/export is a fair axis for a compliance platform, but nothing in the evidence pack shows Secureframe importing customer questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets) or exporting answers back in the original format. The nearest items are Comply AI extracting answers from vendor documents, which is the inbound vendor-risk direction, and Trust Center document sharing; neither addresses format-preserving questionnaire handling for sales.
